verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase provides a natural-language chat interface inside the Firebase console that answers questions, generates code, and helps with troubleshooting. It can generate schemas, queries and mutations from natural language, and with Crashlytics it gives AI root-cause analysis and fix suggestions for crashes. Missing for 10: evidence that it explains the user's own project-specific backend configuration (as opposed to general Firebase product questions), error debugging beyond Crashlytics app crashes (e.g. Functions or backend errors), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
